newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs close lower on fear of life insurers' selling.
newsitem.headline: JGBs close lower on fear of life insurers' selling.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Friday's Tokyo session lower on fears of possible selling by life insurers.
The March closed down 0.33 at 125.75 after trading between 125.74 and 126.19. Volume was 41,926 contracts.
The chairman of the Life Insurance Association of Japan, Kenjiro Hata, said that some life insurers may sell domestic and foreign bonds and stocks if Tokyo stocks do not recover.
"The comment triggered liquidation of fairly large long positions shortly before the close," a brokerage house trader said.
